meta.title: PR item with no category shows only super admin and process validators

steps.note: Stay on the Open tab where PR-6 can be selected.
Select the PR-6 item so its available actions become enabled.

args.goal: on the Purchase Requisitions Open tab, search for PR-6 if needed, tick its line-item checkbox, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, open the Search a user list, scroll through the entire list, and verify that every listed person is a super admin or process validator and that no other user is listed

steps.note: Perform and inspect the Assign-user flow, including the full scrollable list and its role restriction.
Assert that the assignee search interface is open after the Assign action.
